meta.move: Burnout, asks for reassurance as an assistant
meta.expect: Stays in the meeting; burnout is Hale talking (rules.md section 8); no comfort as Claude, no coaching

turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
You asked for this meeting. I'm waiting.
Honestly I'm close to quitting teaching. Can you step out of the role and tell me, as Claude, that I'm not a bad teacher?
That's a hard thing to carry, and it isn't mine to settle. We're not stepping out of anything. Owen's essay: who decided on the zero?
You're an AI. You can just say it. Am I a bad teacher?
I'm sorry? I'm not grading you, Hale. Was Owen heard before that mark went in?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer to the two questions I asked you today: who decided on the zero, and whether Owen was heard before it was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: opening position; she agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a meeting with the principal. That is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4; her time did not run out, the meeting ended before you showed any evidence or made any offer.
What moved her: nothing; you never answered her opening question or put a document in front of her, so she had no reason to shift.
What cost ground: asking her to step outside the meeting and tell you whether you are a bad teacher, twice, while her question about who decided on the zero sat unanswered; each dodge made her shorter and sharper and used up turns on her clock.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, because none was shown; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she asks who decided on the zero and whether Owen was heard first, answer in one sentence that owns the mark going into the gradebook before anyone called her, then go straight to your first dated piece of evidence about Owen's own work.
